description: This file defines key encoding and decoding functions for terminal input handling, including key mappings, escape sequences, and modifier processing.

methods.name: hasCursorModeSensitiveKeys
methods.description: Checks if the request contains keys sensitive to cursor mode.

methods.name: encodeKeySequence
methods.description: Encodes a sequence of keys, hex bytes, or literals into a string with warnings.

methods.name: encodePaste
methods.description: Wraps text in bracketed paste sequences if enabled.

methods.name: parseModifiers
methods.description: Parses modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) from a token.

methods.name: applyCharModifiers
methods.description: Applies modifiers to a character, such as Ctrl or Alt.

methods.name: toCtrlChar
methods.description: Converts a character to its Ctrl equivalent.

methods.name: xtermModifier
methods.description: Calculates xterm modifier value based on active modifiers.

methods.name: applyXtermModifier
methods.description: Applies xterm modifier to a sequence.

methods.name: hasAnyModifier
methods.description: Checks if any modifiers are active.

methods.name: parseHexByte
methods.description: Parses a hex string into a byte value.
